title: Open work, most urgent first
jql: project = SIM AND type != Epic AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, created ASC

title: My work in the current sprint
jql: project = SIM AND sprint in openSprints() AND assignee = currentUser()

title: Open bugs against the next release
jql: project = SIM AND type = Bug AND fixVersion = earliestUnreleasedVersion(SIM) AND resolution IS EMPTY

title: Rework: sent back from review
jql: project = SIM AND status CHANGED FROM "In Review" TO "In Progress"

title: Started before September, still open
jql: project = SIM AND status WAS "In Progress" BEFORE "2026/09/01" AND resolution IS EMPTY

title: Validation work in the memory-model epic
jql: project = SIM AND parent = SIM-1 AND labels = validation

title: Regressions reported in the last 30 days
jql: project = SIM AND type = Bug AND labels = regression AND created >= "-30d"

title: Open, not mine (misses unassigned work)
jql: project = SIM AND type != Epic AND statusCategory != Done AND assignee != currentUser()

title: Open, not mine, including unassigned
jql: project = SIM AND type != Epic AND statusCategory != Done AND (assignee != currentUser() OR assignee IS EMPTY)

title: Bugs fixed in released versions
jql: project = SIM AND type = Bug AND fixVersion in releasedVersions(SIM)
